parsed.explanation: If outed, a visitor faces documented state targeting, not merely social disapproval. Article 489 (6 months-3 years, 170 charges in 2018) and Article 498 morality charges are reported in a Jan 2026 review as applied to trans people for gender expression, with de facto criminalisation, involuntary outing, and wide police discretion. Police abuse is documented: a 2024 allegation of forced genital display, and a 2019 handcuffing/filming/publication of documents of a cross-dressing man. Police disproportionately target perceived LGBTQ people, names are publicised, organisations are blocked, senior officials/religious authority are hostile, and no anti-discrimination recourse exists. A 2022 beating led to arrests, a limited mitigation, but no pattern of protection. This is sustained police-coercive enforcement with imprisonment exposure and unremedied humiliation, below execution/elimination regimes but above unremedied exclusion alone.
